course_summary:
ISEN 689 | Special Topics: Advanced Mathematics for Engineering PhDs | 500 Fall 2025
Instructor: David Huckleberry Gutman | dhgutman@tamu.edu
Meets: MW 1:50-3:50 | ETB-1027
Grading: Homework [25%], Linear Algebra Midterm Exam [25%], Real Analysis Midterm Exam [25%], Comprehensive Final Exam [25%] — A: >90%, B: 80-89.99%, C: 70-79.99%, D: 60-69.99%, F: <60%
Topics: spectral theorems for operators on finite-dimensional real vector spaces, multilinear algebra, Tensors, Determinants, Traces, Real Banach Spaces, finite-dimensional real normed and inner product spaces, Commutative Diagrams, Coordinate and Matrix Representations, Operators on Real Inner Product Spaces, Definition of Vector Spaces, Linear Independence, Spanning Sets, Bases, Dimension, Norms, Inner Products, Definition of Metric Spaces, Sequences in Metric Spaces, Topology of Metric Spaces, Functional Continuity, Limits, Differentiation in ℝ, Differentiation on Finite-dimensional Real Inner Product Spaces, Integration, Basic Set & Function Theory, Basic Number Theory, Ordered Fields, Polynomials, Cartesian Products, draft proofs of basic claims, Prove sophisticated mathematical statements, read and understand textbooks, read and understand proofs, Vector spaces, linear maps, isomorphisms, dual spaces, Sequences, series in ℝ, topology, continuity, differentiation, Sets, functions, numbers, relations, orders, products, fields
Tools: Canvas, Dropbox, LaTeX

1. Homework (25% of total grade ): You will be assigned a homework assignment approximately every week, for a total of about 13 assignments. Each homework will be graded both on style and mathematical correctness. You will have the opportunity to submit a rewrite of each homework assigned on the foundations portion of the course. Provided your initial submission was a good faith attempt to solve all problems, you may rewrite this homework up to full credit. 2. Linear Algebra Midterm Exam (25% of total grade ): In-class exam on linear algebra to be administered after the linear algebra portion of the class.
3. Real Analysis Midterm Exam (25% of total grade ): In-class exam on real analysis to be administered after the real analysis portion of the class.
4. Comprehensive Final Exam (25% of total grade) : Comprehensive final exam to be administered during the final period at the time and location designated by the registrar.
